bio.text: Eli Northrup won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for New York State Assembly District 69 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines.
According to his campaign website, he is a public defender and Policy Director at The Bronx Defenders, where he has led statewide campaigns.

According to Ballotpedia, he was born in Washington, D.C., earned a bachelor's degree from Cornell University in 2007 and a J.D. from New York University in 2011, and also graduated from Georgetown University Law Center in 2015.
